# War Scroll Column 15 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 15 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**15:1** This is the hour of crisis for Israel, the appointed time for war against every nation on earth. For God's people there will be

**15:2** redemption that never ends, but total annihilation for all who follow Belial. Great terror will seize

**15:3** the descendants of Japheth, and Assyria will collapse with no one to save them. The empire of the Kittim will be finished,

**15:4** and wickedness will be crushed without a trace. Not a single one of those who belong to darkness will survive.

**15:5** [...] Those who belong to righteousness will shine to the farthest corners of the earth, growing brighter and brighter until

**15:6** every last season of darkness has run its course. When God's appointed time arrives, His supreme majesty will blaze

**15:7** through all the ages to come, bringing peace and blessing, glory and joy, and long life for all who belong to the light. On the day

**15:8** the Kittim are overthrown, a fierce and devastating battle will rage before the God of Israel. That will be the day

**15:9** God appointed long ago for the final war of annihilation against all who belong to darkness. On that day heaven's army

**15:10** and the human forces will fight side by side in a storm of destruction. Those who belong to light and those who belong to darkness will clash

**15:11** [...] with the power of God, amid the thunderous roar of a vast army and the war cries of angels and soldiers on that catastrophic day.

**15:12** It will be a time of agony for the peo[ple] God has redeemed unlike any[thing they have ever faced.]

**15:13** From its beginning to its end, when eternal redemption is finally complete. On the day they face the Kittim in battle,

**15:14** they will march out to devastating warfare. [...] Three times the forces of light will stand firm and beat back

**15:15** evil, and three times Belial will rally to push back the forces of [...] The foot soldiers

**15:16** will terrify the enemy, [...] but God's power will steel the he[arts of those who fight for the light.] In the seventh round,

**15:17** God's mighty hand will crush [Belial and all] the angels under his command and every person [who serves him.]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 15 describes the final battle's structure and stakes. The seven-round pattern (15:14-17) is rendered for dramatic clarity: three wins for each side, then God's decisive knockout in the seventh. "Sons of Japheth" identified as "descendants of Japheth" (Genesis 10 background). The angelic-human joint warfare (15:9-11) is a signature 1QM concept. "Time of trouble" rendered as "hour of crisis" for urgency. Lacunae preserved where manuscript is damaged.*
